name: Co-op barge
text: A barge in union colours, selling rations at cost to members and with a markup to everyone else. The purser would like to know which you are.

choices.label: Buy 6 supplies
choices.result: Six crates, at the markup. The purser is polite about it.

choices.label: Pay into the strike fund
choices.result: The purser writes you a receipt, and the radio does the rest. The halls will hear you paid in.

choices.label: Move on
choices.result: The purser waves you off, union fashion.
